facts.text: The resort sits on Jimbaran Bay on Bali's southern coast.
facts.excerpt: Nestled within the exclusive Jimbaran Bay on Bali’s southern coast

facts.text: The resort is set in lush tropical gardens alongside a sugar-white sand beach.
facts.excerpt: Nestled in lush tropical gardens alongside a sugar-white sand beach

facts.text: The resort is designed to evoke the ambiance of a tranquil Balinese village.
facts.excerpt: InterContinental Bali invites you to immerse yourself in the ambiance of a tranquil Balinese village

facts.text: The resort was the first of its kind built on the shores of Jimbaran Bay, overlooking the sunsets.
facts.excerpt: was the first of its kind to be built on these beautiful shores, overlooking picturesque sunsets

facts.text: Rooms, suites and private villas are spread across six separate wings that blend modern convenience with traditional Balinese architecture.
facts.excerpt: rooms, suites, and private villas gracefully unfolds in six separate wings, artfully blending modern convenience with signature elements of traditional Balinese architecture

facts.text: The Classica Villa measures 378 square meters and has one king bed and two single beds.
facts.excerpt: Classica Villa Room Size: 378 sq. m. – 378 sq. m. Beds: 1 King Bed and 2 Single Beds

facts.text: Club InterContinental offers a private lounge experience focused on privacy, exclusivity and intuitive service.
facts.excerpt: Enter a world of understated elegance at Club InterContinental, where privacy, exclusivity and intuitive service define the art of refined living.

facts.text: The Nirvana pool, the resort's largest, overlooks Jimbaran Bay.
facts.excerpt: Choose between our stunning Nirvana pool, the largest, overlooking Jimbaran Bay.

facts.text: Other pools include the Balinese Bath, Fountain and family 'Fun' pools, plus a Club pool exclusive to InterContinental Club guests.
facts.excerpt: Or, opt for the Balinese Bath, Fountain, ‘Fun’ (family) or Club pool, exclusive to InterContinental Club guests.

facts.text: The resort has six pools.
facts.excerpt: you're invited to experience our tranquil spa, six serene pools, and fitness center

facts.text: Spa Uluwatu offers hydrotherapy, a sauna and steam bathing.
facts.excerpt: Spa Uluwatu - **Spa Amenities** - Hydro Therapy - Masseuse - Sauna - Steam Bathing

facts.text: Spa Uluwatu treatments include body scrubs, body wraps, facials, foot reflexology and therapy baths.
facts.excerpt: - Body Scrub - Body Wrap - Facials - Foot Bath - Foot Reflexology

facts.text: KO is the resort's signature Japanese restaurant, combining Balinese architecture with Japanese gardens, with teppanyaki, a sushi and tempura restaurant, and a sake cocktail lounge.
facts.excerpt: Our signature Japanese restaurant, award winning KO offers a stylish dining experience infusing Balinese architecture with Japanese gardens and aesthetics.

facts.text: Bella Cucina serves a Mediterranean menu, with al fresco tables beside lantern-lit tropical gardens or a private indoor glass conservatory.
facts.excerpt: Dine al fresco under the stars, next to tropical gardens illuminated with lanterns, or reserve the private indoor glass conservatory with chandeliers and gold plated cutlery.

facts.text: Sunset Beach Bar & Grill sits on the beachfront among coconut palms, for drinks, dining and sunsets over Jimbaran Bay.
facts.excerpt: Escape amidst the swaying coconut palms and white sandy beaches of Jimbaran Bay to savor drinks, dine, and witness breathtaking crimson streaked sunsets.

facts.text: The concierge can arrange a traditional fishing boat trip on Jimbaran Bay.
facts.excerpt: Our concierge will arrange a fishing boat to take you out on the bay, to experience firsthand this authentic local way of life.

facts.text: The beach offers chairs, towel service and umbrellas.
facts.excerpt: Beach chairs Towel service Umbrellas

facts.text: The resort offers babysitting and children's activities on site.
facts.excerpt: - Babysitting - Children's activities onsite - Nanny for hire

facts.text: The resort is about a 15-minute drive from Ngurah Rai International Airport.
facts.excerpt: It’s also only a 15-minute drive from Ngurah Rai International Airport

facts.text: Uluwatu Temple, popular for viewing the sunset, is about 30 minutes from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: It takes about 30 minutes to get there from the hotel.

facts.text: Jenggala Ceramic, about a 5-minute drive away, lets visitors paint or make their own pot.
facts.excerpt: This is the only ceramic factory located close to the resort (only a 5 minute drive). It has a wide selection of ceramics, glasses, and tabletop accessories. You are also able to paint or make your own pot.

facts.text: Meeting facilities are in authentic Balinese-style pavilion buildings within their own dedicated wing.
facts.excerpt: modern audio-visual technologies in authentic Balinese-style pavilion buildings within its own dedicated wing

facts.text: Golf is available off-site at New Kuta Golf.
facts.excerpt: New Kuta Golf Located off-site

facts.text: Pets are not allowed at the resort.
facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at InterContinental Bali Resort.

facts.text: Rooms and suites may include a balcony, garden view and separate bath and walk-in shower.
facts.excerpt: - Balcony - Garden View - Separate Bath and Walk-in Shower

contradictions.note: p1 description says six pools; p1 FAQ says 1 outdoor pool

InterContinental Bali Resort has 1 outdoor pool.
